page.layout: One block of running text in the centre of the page. Margin notes in the left margin, beside the text at two places. No right margin text. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Eandem".
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: minor : argillofo ut plurimum, & ubere ad pascua pariter ac frumenta folo : palustris tamen & nemorofus, quâ Dullarto adjacet, quaque Ostergois ad meridiem cohæret, sabulofus hic illic quâ Drentiæ conjungitur. Hanc ego regionem à Lavicâ in Amafum ac Dullartum, Agri ue-men.minoris Frifiæ nomine affectam interdum avorum & proavorum nostrorum memoriâ reperio. Simul ufus dudum invaluit, ab urbe Groningâ, sive quòd in folo ejus hæc fit ad austrinum limitem, (quod tamen in dubium trahunt nonnulli,) sive quòd fœderibus antiquitus cum eâ connexa, seu utramque ob causam simul, Groninganam vocitare. Nunc ex decreto in actis publicis non nisi Vmlandia, id est regio [illegible, ~8 letters] dicitur. Agri di-vifio.Divifa quondam in plures provinciolas, ceu populos quosdam minores, legibus & imperio inter se distinctos, quos tamen commune fœdus & respublica quæ-dam major plerumque in unum rursus colligebat. Et sunt ejus divifionis etiam nunc in usu notissima vestigia, paulò post exponenda.

page.notes: The Greek word after "regio" is not legible on the scan; it is marked as illegible and not guessed. The left margin note "Agri ue-men." is uncertain in its first word ("ue" could be "uc" or "uo"); it is copied as it appears. The catchword "Eandem" is printed at the lower right and is placed in the bottom margin; it is also shown as a foot line in the text. The printed rule above "post exponenda." is a separator and is not transcribed. The word "Ostergois" may be printed "Ostergois"; the long s is written as plain s. Marginal note placements are approximate beside the lines "minoris Frifiæ" and "Divifa quondam".
